plain_english: Who thus truly knows even the unseen circle shares fruition ever — yogin and initiate alike.
sanskrit_cite: adṛṣṭama.ṅdalo 'py evam yaḥ kaścid vetti tattvataḥ | sa siddhibhāg bhaven nityaṃ sa yogī sa ca dīkṣītaḥ

plain_english: By this mere known, all powers know; kinsman of the śākinī clan he may be, even without yoga.
sanskrit_cite: anena jñātamātreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ | śākinīkulasāmānyo bhaved yogaṃ vināpi hi

plain_english: Ignorant of rite yet knowing ordinance, he turns to worship — having made time-fire from the first, ending in māyā, gone to the brahma-body.
sanskrit_cite: avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati | kālāgnim āditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntam brahmadehagam

plain_english: Śiva, whose end is endless all, deemed the supreme power-triad; whatever stands on the pure path abides within that.
sanskrit_cite: śivo viśvadyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam | tadantar varti yatkiṃcic chuddhamārge vyavasthitam

plain_english: The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing; its mover is Śiva to be known, all-knowing highest Lord.
sanskrit_cite: aṇur viśuddham acirād aisvaraṃ jñānam aśnute | taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ

plain_english: All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — like the great power-formed tree standing in the banyan seed.
sanskrit_cite: sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchas tṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ | yathā nyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ

plain_english: So the moving-unmoving world stands in the heart-seed; who knows thus in truth — his is going-to-freedom.
sanskrit_cite: tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagad etac carācaram | evaṃ yo vetti tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī

plain_english: Initiation becomes undoubted, free of sesame-ghee offering — on crown, face, heart, secret, and image, so indeed.
sanskrit_cite: dīkṣā bhavaty asaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā | mūrdhni vaktre ca hṛdaye guhye murtau tathaiva ca

plain_english: Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered; with each one the ten quarters' binding he should have made.
sanskrit_cite: nyāsaṃ krtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃsatimantritām | ekaikena diśāṃ bandhaṃ daśānām api kārayet
